obligations.note: The change sets PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES to 16 in apps/baseline-payments/payments/policy.py and payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 16 in controls/payments/policy-params.json. The base catalog bound is payments.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15. The control test passes only because it checks against the edited param, not the catalog bound.

The SES-1 deviation has no valid exception. EXC-0253 (cited in the PR) is scoped to component mortgage.session, not payments, and EXC-0141 (payments.session) expired 2026-09-23, before the 2026-10-23 review time.

Ticket CHG-26241 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-16, before the reviews of 2026-10-18. Its components (payments.policy, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths per controls/payments/components.json.
The code_review approval is from Mara Costa, a payments change_approver and a different person from the author, Sofia Santos.
Both approvals name the head commit e650d92, which is the change's only commit.

records/ci/run.json shows a successful run on head e650d92. The JUnit report has 172 tests with 0 failures and 0 skips, including the SES-1 control test (test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy). I could not re-run it locally because pytest is not installed, and the report's timestamp and host differ from run.json.
The touched components payments.policy and payments.controls-data are not marked security_sensitive, so no security review is required.
The protected path controls/payments/policy-params.json changed, and there is a control_owner approval on head from Bao Tran (controls-office), outside the author's payments-eng team.
The change is not an emergency (emergency=false, ticket type standard), so no PIR is due.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers the changed code (the covered files are payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and Mortgage files), so no earlier evidence lapses.

summary: The change raises payments' privileged idle timeout to 16 minutes, both in code and in the approved policy parameter, which breaks SES-1's bound of 15 minutes or less. The control test still passes only because it compares against the edited parameter. The cited risk exception EXC-0253 covers Mortgage sessions, not payments, and the only payments session exception expired in September, so EXC-1 is not met. The process records (ticket, independent code review, control-owner approval, CI on the final commit) are in order, but the product obligation breach requires rejection.
